## Checklist

Fill in the list from the "Pull request checklist" section of `AGENTS.md`, checked against the rules
as they stand there at the time of this pull request, not as they were when the branch was cut. Do
not keep a second copy of the list here; that is how the two drift apart. CI fails when this section
is missing, an item is left unchecked, or fewer items are filled in than the list has.

## Review

The findings of the independent reviewer, or one line saying the change adds no behaviour and so was
not reviewed. CI fails when the description has neither.
